CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.severity: the September experiment, as frozen, CANNOT ANSWER THE QUESTION IT WAS DESIGNED FOR
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.mechanism: R_REF = (0,0,0). The frozen rule is R_30_MED <= R_REF component-wise on non-negative rates, so T+30 qualifies ONLY IF its revision is EXACTLY ZERO.
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.already_falsified: the 2026-08-24 T+1 -> T+7 measurement alone gives minute-key additions of 215 and an OHLCV revision rate of 1.479%. R_30 for that session must be at least that large. The criterion is therefore guaranteed to return NOT QUALIFIED, for T+30 and for every other M.
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.ROOT_CAUSE: R_REF and R_30 measure STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT WINDOWS
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.R_REF_window: age 915d -> age ~2,100d — residual drift of an ALREADY-MATURE vintage over 1,185 further days
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.R_30_window: age 1d -> age 30d — revision ACCUMULATED FROM RAW over 29 days
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.why_that_breaks_it: comparing accumulation-from-raw against residual-drift-when-mature is not apples to apples. The reference is not a tolerance for the thing being measured.
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.WHAT_IS_STILL_VALID: the long-lag measurement itself is a clean and strong result: by 915 days the data are frozen. Only its USE as a nonexceedance threshold for R_30 is broken.
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.STATUS: REPORTED BEFORE ANY T+30 RESULT EXISTS. No T+30 measurement has been taken, so correcting the criterion now is a pre-registration fix, not a post hoc adjustment.
CRITICAL_DESIGN_DEFECT_IN_THE_FROZEN_CRI.NOT_DONE: I did NOT weaken, rescale or reinterpret the frozen criterion on my own authority.

PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.estimand_wanted: at what maturity M do the data stop changing
PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.measurable_form: INCREMENTAL stability between CONSECUTIVE vintages of the same session, rather than cumulative change from the raw baseline
PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.concretely: for each of the three registered sessions capture vintages at several maturities and compute R(V_a -> V_b) for consecutive pairs. M qualifies when the increment from M onward is zero, i.e. R(V_M -> V_later) = (0,0,0), which IS directly comparable to the long-lag reference.
PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.cost: one additional refetch per session per maturity point; each is a separate paid call and a separate authorisation
PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.already_available_for_free: 2026-08-24 already has T+1 and T+7 vintages, so its first increment is measured
PROPOSED_REFORMULATION_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.alternative_if_rejected: abandon the empirical settlement study and freeze a maturity by judgement, recording it as JUDGEMENT_NOT_MEASURED
